verification_limitations: No claim that hiding is security; selecting hidden sources remains an explicit product decision.

sources.title: Row Properties
supported_claims: Parsing row properties requires cellStyles; utility skipHidden can exclude hidden rows.
verification_limitations: Metadata extraction has a cost that was not measured; filtered visibility and manual hiding require producer fixtures.

sources.title: Formulae
supported_claims: SheetJS CE does not calculate formula results; formula strings and array-formula range metadata are separate from cached data.
verification_limitations: No formula engine is proposed. Cache freshness cannot be established from decoder success.

sources.title: Dates and Times
supported_claims: Spreadsheet serial dates and number formats differ from absolute JavaScript times; 1900 includes fictitious leap-day compatibility; UTC/local interpretation and conversion options matter.
verification_limitations: One sample on the page has inverted date1904 comments; use W11/W04 for flag meaning and prove conversions with real files. No timezone behavior was executed.
supported_sections: How Spreadsheets Understand Time; Relative Epochs; How Files Store Dates and Times; How SheetJS handles Dates and Times

sources.title: Web Workers
supported_claims: SheetJS documents passing a local File into a worker and reading its bytes there; classic and module-worker examples exist; hosted production assets are encouraged.
verification_limitations: Documentation includes version-specific browser claims; no current-browser compatibility, strict CSP, cancellation, responsiveness, or memory test was run.
supported_sections: Installation; ECMAScript Module Support; User-Submitted File

sources.title: Defined Names
supported_claims: Named references have workbook/sheet scope; names can point to A1-style ranges and may use relative references.
verification_limitations: A defined name is not necessarily a simple table; arbitrary names/formulas must not be treated as safe rectangular regions.

sources.title: VBA and Macros
supported_claims: Optional bookVBA extraction exposes embedded macro data; macro-enabled workbooks and macro-dependent formulas are separate concerns.
verification_limitations: No macros or spreadsheet automation were executed; not evidence for safe full workbook execution.

sources.title: ExcelJS README at v4.4.0
supported_claims: ExcelJS documents XLSX buffer loading, browser document workbooks, and cached formula results without calculation. Its streaming reader/writer are excluded from the browser build.
verification_limitations: Tag-specific README fetched through GitHub plugin (blob e70b1d2be90da7e07af27884340a7783752784fd). Current master README also retrieved via web; neither was browser-tested.
supported_sections: Installation; Importing; Reading XLSX; Browser; Formula Value; Tables

sources.title: ExcelJS package.json at v4.4.0

verification_limitations: Read-only GitHub plugin fetch, blob 7a70a5e13145a917b57806a6998b8d5e04f47acd. No module field/exports field in inspected package; actual Vite interop remains untested.
supported_sections: version; license; main; browser; types; dependencies

sources.title: ExcelJS latest release metadata and v4.4.0 release
supported_claims: GitHub latest-release endpoint returned v4.4.0, a non-prerelease published 2023-10-19T19:57:46Z; canonical release page is https://github.com/exceljs/exceljs/releases/tag/v4.4.0.
verification_limitations: Latest tagged release is not a complete picture of post-release maintenance or vulnerability state. Endpoint fetched read-only via GitHub plugin.

sources.title: Create, view, or download a file

supported_sections: Download a copy of a file

sources.title: Export MIME types for Google Workspace documents
supported_claims: The export matrix lists XLSX, ODS, PDF, zipped HTML, CSV, and TSV; CSV/TSV are explicitly single-sheet in this API context.
verification_limitations: The table labels CSV/TSV first-sheet only for the API. It must not establish which sheet the manual UI chooses. Documentation is factual evidence only; no API integration is proposed.

sources.title: Supported file formats: Google Sheets TSV export
supported_claims: Official manual instructions identify File > Download as > Tab-separated values (.tsv, current sheet).
verification_limitations: Manual TSV behavior is documented; equivalent current-tab CSV behavior and producer fidelity still require an exported fixture or independent official confirmation. Other feed rules on this page are not general TSV rules.

sources.title: Work on Google Docs, Sheets, & Slides offline
supported_claims: Offline use is tied to supported browser/profile, Google Docs Offline, account selection, and managed local site data.

sources.title: Files and folders overview
